A [[human]] '''reporter''' that was present in a lounge at [[Gate 9]] of the [[Imperial Senate Building]] in [[2 BBY]] when [[Senior Senator]] [[Mon Mothma]] delivered a speech denouncing the [[Ghorman Massacre]] which they watched via the lounge's [[viewscreen]]. After the speech they were part of a crowd of [[journalist]]s that surrounded Mothma asking for comments on the speech when she and [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]] exited the [[turbolift]] from the senate chamber. As Mothma made her way through the crowd they were next to a human named [[Beska]] drew and aimed her [[blaster]] on Mothma claiming to be making an [[Imperial Security Bureau]] authorized arrest. To which the report ducked to the ground with their hand over their head. Before the arrest could continue, [[Erskin Semaj]], an aid to Mothma call Beska a rebel spy which provided enough of a distraction for Andor to draw [[Clem's blaster pistol|his blaster]] and shoot Beska. After picking up Beska's blaster, Semaj used it to cover [[Escape from the Senate|Mothma and Andor's escape]] before he too left the senate building. During the incident, the reporter had [[color|brown]] [[hair]], brown [[eye]]s, light skin and wore a red [[jacket]] over lavender [[clothing|shirt]] and a large [[necklace]].<ref name="Welcome to the Rebellion" />

==Behind the scenes==
The reporter appeared in the [[Welcome to the Rebellion|ninth episode]] of the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the live-action [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]''<ref name="Welcome to the Rebellion" /> which aired on [[May 6]], [[2025]].<ref name="Trailer News">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}}</ref> They were portrayed by [[Fiona Skinner]] in the episode and credited as simply "Senate Reporter #1".<ref name="Welcome to the Rebellion" />
